text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text: Does the pain feel like an electric shock or burning sensation, and have you noticed any difficulty lifting your foot or toe? REQUEST TEST: Lumbar_MRI

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Evidence of L5-S1 disc herniation impinging on the adjacent nerve root.

speaker: Doctor
text: The MRI confirms an L5-S1 disc herniation, which explains your radiating pain. Do you have any loss of bladder or bowel control, or numbness in the saddle area? DIAGNOSIS READY: Lumbar Disc Herniation with Radiculopathy
